overview.description: The ProShares Ultra Nasdaq Biotechnology (BIB) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the NASDAQ / Biotechnology index. The fund provides 2x daily exposure to a modified market-cap-weighted index of biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies listed on NASDAQ. BIB was launched on Apr 8, 2010 and is issued by ProShares.
